validity.recommendation: Keep the row; correct length 62->61 km and update status to operating (see status_reviews).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real. The GEM page rested on a SINGLE citation to iranertebat.com (a B2B project/tender directory listing), which is dead (url_verifier ConnectTimeout) and not an independent news source — an existence red flag on its face. But independent open-web search found two separate news agencies naming this exact line: Mehr News Agency (mehrnews.com, 16 Mehr 1404 = 2025-10-07, 'خط لوله ۲۰ اینچ بهبهان - گچساران به شبکه گاز پیوست') and SHANA (shana.ir, official Oil Ministry agency, 2026 year-review, 'خط لوله بهبهان - گچساران نیز به طول ۶۱ کیلومتر به شبکه گاز پیوسته است'). Both give 61 km, 20-inch, Behbahan->Gachsaran, built/executed by شرکت مهندسی و توسعه گاز ایران (Iran Gas Engineering & Development Co, IGEDC — NIGC's development arm). CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission' is CORRECT — a 20-inch trunk from the national grid at Behbahan feeding Behbahan & Gachsaran cities plus Gachsaran petrochemical, Behbahan cement factory and Lishter power plant, with 16/12/10-inch industrial/urban branch takeoffs (the branches are the distribution/feeder pieces; the mainline is transmission). DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of any roster pipeline — it is a distinct short regional line in Khuzestan/Kohgiluyeh-Boyer-Ahmad, unrelated to the IGAT trunks, Iran-Pakistan, Iran-Oman, Russia-Iran, Dauletabad-Sarakhs or the offshore lines. SPEC caveat: GEM length 62 km ('approximate 62 km' per the dead iranertebat listing) vs 61 km stated by BOTH independent sources — recommend correcting to 61 km (immaterial ~1 km). Diameter 20 in CONFIRMED by both. Capacity blank — no transmission-capacity figure published; left blank (not fabricated). ProposalYear 2022 could not be independently verified (only the dead iranertebat listing supports it) — left as-is, noted unverified.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'National Iranian Oil Co' to 'National Iranian Gas Co' (built/operated by NIGC via IGEDC).
validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION ERROR: GEM records Owner1 = National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC), 100% — wrong company for a gas transmission trunk. Both independent sources attribute construction/commissioning to شرکت مهندسی و توسعه گاز ایران (Iran Gas Engineering & Development Company, IGEDC), the development/EPC subsidiary of the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC). Iranian gas transmission assets belong to NIGC, not to the oil company NIOC. Recommend Owner1 = National Iranian Gas Co. Owner [ref] was blank in the sheet; staged as a fill with the two verified refs.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: STATUS CHANGE construction -> operating. Sheet LastUpdated 2025-07-23 still shows 'construction'; newer independent evidence supersedes it. Mehr News Agency (2025-10-07) reports the 20-inch Behbahan-Gachsaran line 'به شبکه گاز پیوست' with 'موفقیت عملیات تزریق گاز و آغاز بهره‌برداری' (successful gas-injection and start of operation). SHANA (official Oil Ministry agency, 1404 year-review) independently confirms the 61 km line 'به شبکه گاز پیوسته است'. Two independent agencies, both past-tense operational -> operating. Operation began ~Oct 2025 -> StartYear1 = 2025. Earlier Iran Petroleum/OGJ notes had called it 'scheduled to become operational' (older, pre-commissioning) — superseded by the Oct-2025/2026 commissioning reports. GEM's existing StartYear1=2024 (unsourced) is inconsistent with the evidence and should become 2025. Tier high (2 independent, value present).

summary: P6006 Behbahan-Gachsaran is REAL and correctly classified as transmission (not a duplicate); but GEM owner is wrong (NIOC->NIGC/IGEDC), length should be 61 not 62 km, and status is now OPERATING (commissioned ~Oct 2025 per Mehr+SHANA), not construction.
